servedAuthorities.case: the form Node's HTTP/2 client sends for http://[::1]:50051
the form Node sends for a four-digit port, which is also a valid IPv6 address on its own
an unbracketed global IPv6 address and port
an unbracketed IPv4-mapped IPv6 address and port
a bracketed IPv6 address and port

rejectedAuthorities.case: an unbracketed IPv6 address with an out-of-range port
an unbracketed IPv6 address with no port
an unbracketed IPv6 address with a zone ID

longAuthorities.case: a 10 KiB host name, which is a valid authority
a 10 KiB run of digits, which is not a valid authority

configuredMessageLimit.case: a server built with readMaxBytes of 5 MiB, so a message over the 4 MiB default is served

earlyAnswer.case: a client-streaming handler that answers after the first message, while its client sends one message every 200 ms under a 1 second deadline

cancelledBidi.case: a bidi handler that replies every 20 ms until it is stopped, and a client that cancels the call after three replies

refusedClientsConnected.case: the generated client and connect-node's gRPC, gRPC-web and Connect clients each get one 5 MiB message refused and keep their connections while the server stops

unfinishedUpload.case: a client that keeps sending a 5 MiB message after the server refused it, waiting for the server to close the stream as curl and buf curl do

stalledConnection.case: a 16 MiB answer fills a connection whose client stops reading for a second, and the server refuses a 5 MiB message on that connection meanwhile
